intro: Stitches is a colossal, stitched-together undead abomination that terrorizes Duskwood. Spawning in the western reaches of the zone, the monster relentlessly marches down the main road toward Darkshire, slaughtering unwary travelers and overwhelming Night Watch checkpoints.

sections.t: The Terror of the Main Road
p: Stitches is an undead abomination assembled from harvested corpses and unholy sorcery. Appearing near Abercrombie's shack northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery, the lumbering monstrosity immediately sets out eastward along the road toward Darkshire. Imbued with immense physical strength and relentless malice, Stitches tears through any Night Watch checkpoints stationed along the thoroughfare—including the defense camp across from Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and the outpost outside the Rotting Orchard—bringing outright slaughter to unwary travelers and town defenders alike.
